fusions.name: Drifting Barb
fusions.desc: Sends a barb drifting at an enemy up to 6 tiles away that deals 7 damage, rising to 1.3 times as much at full reach, and leaves it [Slowed] for 3 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Settling Weight
fusions.desc: Settles your spined bulk onto everything within 3.5 tiles, dealing 26 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, stripping 12% of their armour for 8 seconds and slowing each by 30%.

fusions.name: Long Float
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Layered Bristles
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack (42% at full) before your health takes damage. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds. Your armour rises by 5% at all times.
